applies_to: the first step of any customer-facing sequence

forbidden_substrings_case_insensitive.reason: Polite throat-clearing flags the message as an automated broadcast.

forbidden_patterns.reason: A link in touch one tells the reader it is a broadcast. The destination belongs to a later step.

forbidden_cta_shapes.reason: A yes-oriented ask triggers the commitment trap. Design for a safe no.

the_core_rule.name: do_not_answer_your_own_question
the_core_rule.statement: The body asks one question and stops. It must not contain a second sentence that pitches, lists, offers, or explains.
the_core_rule.why: Named in the corpus as the single most common mistake in win-back email. Adding the second sentence solves the mystery and removes the reason to reply.
